text: Formal Reasoning Meets LLMs: Towards AI for Mathematics and Verification LLMs Alone are Not Enough • Current math LLMs rely heavily on data and verifiability • Data scarcity • Limited to data-rich domains, e.g., pre-college math • Cannot tackle advanced math or proofs • Lack of verifiability • Solutions can only be evaluated by comparing with the ground truth • Limited to problems with numeric solutions, e.g., GSM8K, MATH • Not applicable to most problems in advanced math 29
